fixture_type: design-level two-session concurrency scenarios; not executed PostgreSQL tests

session_a: LOCK affected scope mutexes rank 3 in canonical order
session_b: Attempt the same mapping and scope set in the same canonical order
Wait at the first conflicting row; do not acquire scope before identity rows
Re-read mapping versions and fail/retry whole transaction if stale
scenarios.expected: No cycle; one serial order; stale mapping cannot authorize a promotion.

session_a: Increment login epoch and revoke mapping
Append mutation manifest/events and audit head
session_b: LOCK same login binding, mapping and session rows in ranks 0–2
If session B wins first, validate old epoch and commit before disablement; otherwise observe new epoch and reject
scenarios.expected: Revocation linearization is the disablement commit; no post-commit stale approval succeeds.

session_a: Lock scope A then scope B by tenant UUID/BU UUID byte order
Acquire later classes in rank order
session_b: Request scope B then scope A but canonical acquisition normalizes to A then B
Acquire later classes in rank order
scenarios.expected: Both transactions use identical scope ordering; no reverse-order deadlock.

session_a: Pre-lock all referenced parent rows at declared ranks
Run only triggers that validate pre-locked rows
session_b: Wait on same ranked row; no trigger may acquire a lower-rank lock
scenarios.expected: FK KEY SHARE and trigger effects are represented in the declared plan; no hidden inversion.

session_a: RLS predicate reads authenticated scope without row/advisory locks
session_b: Run competing mapping or scope mutation
Acquire all locks only in the explicit function lock plan
scenarios.expected: RLS cannot introduce a hidden lock or change lock order.

session_a: Inject test-only conflict at a later rank
session_b: Acquire same classes in canonical order
Complete or wait until A aborts
scenarios.expected: A bounded retry starts again at rank 0 and repeats authentication, epoch and eligibility checks; no partial writes survive.
